cohort_note: VSE has DIVESTED its Federal & Defense segment (FDS Sale, 2024) and Fleet segment (April 2025). It now operates as a single Aviation segment focused on commercial / business & general aviation / cargo / rotorcraft / military aftermarket MRO and parts distribution. The 10-K names NO specific Pentagon Program Elements (PE numbers), NO specific named DoD programs (Skyborg, CCA, SDA Tracking Layer, etc.), and no DoD-customer revenue-concentration disclosures. Defense-aviation exposure that remains is generic O&M sustainment-type work (rotorcraft, military aftermarket parts distribution), which sits in O&M budgets and IDIQ vehicles — outside the J-Book corpus (which is RDT&E + Procurement PEs). High UNVERIFIABLE rate is expected by design.

claims.claim_text: VSE's business operations are managed as a single reportable operating segment: Aviation, following the sales of the Federal and Defense (FDS Sale, Feb 2024) and Fleet (April 2025) segments. The Aviation segment is a leading provider of aftermarket parts distribution and MRO for components and engine accessories supporting commercial, B&GA operators, with military and defense as one of several customer verticals.

claims.claim_text: VSE entered into a stock purchase agreement on January 29, 2026 to acquire Precision Aviation Group (PAG) for ~$2.025 billion in cash and equity (plus up to $125M earn-out). PAG is described as supporting B&GA, rotorcraft, and defense markets. The acquisition is funded by February 2026 offerings (~$1.3B net proceeds) and new senior secured financing.
